title: Sow
description: Sow contract normalized from the DocuBricks Legal library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-legal-sow
  title: Sow
  description: Sow contract normalized from the DocuBricks Legal library.
  version: legal_sow_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: legal/sow
    sourcePath: Schemas/legal/sow
    sourceVersion: legal_sow_v1
    sourceDigest: ebb9ff8927461672a03533f8d9711fa803fb458303e67e6ae6cc188331497a08
spec:
  documentType: sow
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - amendment-number
        - due-date
        - effective-date
        - end-date
        - payment-terms
        - vendor-contact
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - acceptance-criteria-described
        - change-order-process-described
        - currency
        - deliverables
        - description
        - governing-law
        - pricing-model
        - project-description
        - sow-number
        - sow-title
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - payment-schedule
        - total-contract-value
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - client-name
        - ip-ownership
        - name
        - vendor-name
    - id: risk-and-compliance
      title: Risk And Compliance
      description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - client-contact
        - client-po-number
  fields:
    - id: sow-number
      name: sow_number
      label: Sow Number
      description: 'The unique SOW identifier or reference number (e.g., "SOW-2025-007", "SOW #3")'
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/sow_number
    - id: sow-title
      name: sow_title
      label: Sow Title
      description: Descriptive title of the statement of work
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/sow_title
    - id: effective-date
      name: effective_date
      label: Effective Date
      description: The date the SOW becomes effective, format YYYY-MM-DD
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/effective_date
    - id: end-date
      name: end_date
      label: End Date
      description: The date the SOW terminates or the project is expected to complete, format YYYY-MM-DD
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/end_date
    - id: amendment-number
      name: amendment_number
      label: Amendment Number
      description: If this is an amendment to an existing SOW, the amendment number as integer (null if original)
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/amendment_number
    - id: client-name
      name: client_name
      label: Client Name
      description: Full legal name of the client organization
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/client_name
    - id: client-contact
      name: client_contact
      label: Client Contact
      description: Name of the primary client contact person (project manager, sponsor, or signatory)
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/client_contact
    - id: client-po-number
      name: client_po_number
      label: Client Po Number
      description: Client's Purchase Order number referenced in the SOW (null if not present)
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/client_po_number
    - id: vendor-name
      name: vendor_name
      label: Vendor Name
      description: Full legal name of the vendor / service provider organization
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/vendor_name
    - id: vendor-contact
      name: vendor_contact
      label: Vendor Contact
      description: Name of the primary vendor contact person (project manager or account manager)
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/vendor_contact
    - id: project-description
      name: project_description
      label: Project Description
      description: Brief description of the project or engagement scope (up to 300 characters)
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/project_description
    - id: deliverables
      name: deliverables
      label: Deliverables
      description: "Array of deliverable objects. Each object must contain:"
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/deliverables
    - id: name
      name: name
      label: Name
      description: Short name of the deliverable
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/name
    - id: description
      name: description
      label: Description
      description: Brief description of the deliverable (up to 150 chars)
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/description
    - id: due-date
      name: due_date
      label: Due Date
      description: Due date in format YYYY-MM-DD (null if not specified for this deliverable)
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/due_date
    - id: pricing-model
      name: pricing_model
      label: Pricing Model
      description: "The pricing structure. One of: Fixed | T&M | Retainer | Milestone | Other"
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/pricing_model
    - id: total-contract-value
      name: total_contract_value
      label: Total Contract Value
      description: Total value of the SOW as decimal (null if T&M with no cap, or retainer with no stated total)
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/total_contract_value
    - id: currency
      name: currency
      label: Currency
      description: Currency code (e.g., "USD", "EUR", "GBP")
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/currency
    - id: payment-terms
      name: payment_terms
      label: Payment Terms
      description: Payment terms as stated (e.g., "Net 30", "50% upfront / 50% on completion", "Monthly in arrears")
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/payment_terms
    - id: payment-schedule
      name: payment_schedule
      label: Payment Schedule
      description: Description of the payment schedule or milestones for billing (up to 200 chars)
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/payment_schedule
    - id: acceptance-criteria-described
      name: acceptance_criteria_described
      label: Acceptance Criteria Described
      description: Boolean — true if the SOW contains defined acceptance criteria for deliverables
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/acceptance_criteria_described
    - id: change-order-process-described
      name: change_order_process_described
      label: Change Order Process Described
      description: Boolean — true if the SOW describes a change order or change control process
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/change_order_process_described
    - id: ip-ownership
      name: ip_ownership
      label: Ip Ownership
      description: "Who owns intellectual property created under this SOW. One of: Client | Vendor | Joint | null"
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/ip_ownership
    - id: governing-law
      name: governing_law
      label: Governing Law
      description: The state or jurisdiction whose laws govern the SOW (e.g., "CA", "NY", "DE")
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/governing_law
  validationRules:
    - id: document-id-present
      severity: error
      description: Every extracted record must carry a document_id — system invariant required for lineage tracking,
        audit trail, and deduplication
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: document_id
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: document_id
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: document_id IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(document_id)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: avg-confidence-acceptable
      severity: warning
      description: Overall extraction confidence below 0.68 indicates the document may be a scan of low quality,
        partially missing, or in an unsupported format; route to quarantine for human review
      rule:
        op: gte
        left:
          field: avg_confidence
        right:
          value: 0.68
      sourceExpression: avg_confidence >= 0.68
      supported: true
    - id: effective-date-not-null
      severity: warning
      description: Effective date is required to anchor the project timeline, trigger billing schedules, and manage
        SLA obligations; records without it are not actionable
      rule:
        op: present
        field: effective_date
      sourceExpression: effective_date IS NOT NULL
      supported: true
    - id: total-contract-value-positive
      severity: warning
      description: Contract value must be positive when present; zero or negative values indicate an extraction
        error or corrupt financial data
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: total_contract_value
          - op: gt
            left:
              field: total_contract_value
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: total_contract_value IS NULL OR total_contract_value > 0
      supported: true
    - id: deliverables-present
      severity: warning
      description: A SOW should define at least one deliverable; absence may indicate extraction failure or an
        incomplete document requiring human review
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: deliverables
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: deliverables
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: deliverables IS NOT NULL AND JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(deliverables) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: payment-terms-present
      severity: warning
      description: Payment terms are required for accounts payable / receivable processing; absence blocks invoice
        automation
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: payment_terms
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: payment_terms
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: payment_terms IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(payment_terms)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: end-date-after-effective-date
      severity: warning
      description: End date must be after effective date if both are present; inversion indicates a date extraction
        or data entry error
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: end_date
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: effective_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              field: end_date
            right:
              field: effective_date
      sourceExpression: end_date IS NULL OR effective_date IS NULL OR end_date > effective_date
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      total_contract_value:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Contract value drives accounts payable/receivable workflows, budget tracking, and financial
          reporting; errors cascade to P&L impacts and procurement thresholds
      sow_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: SOW number is the primary identifier for linking invoices, purchase orders, and deliverable
          tracking; extraction errors cause reconciliation failures
      payment_terms:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Payment terms directly drive invoice automation and cash flow management; inaccurate extraction
          causes late payments or disputes
      ip_ownership:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: IP ownership classification affects asset registration, licensing strategy, and competitive
          positioning; errors have long-term legal consequences
      effective_date:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Effective date anchors SLA obligations, billing start, and project timeline; must be accurately
          extracted
      end_date:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: End date triggers project close-out, final invoicing, and renewal evaluation; accuracy required for
          contract lifecycle management
      client_name:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Client identity required for CRM linkage, revenue attribution, and contract reporting
      vendor_name:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Vendor identity required for vendor management, OFAC screening, and payment routing
      pricing_model:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Pricing model determines billing automation logic and financial controls; errors cause incorrect
          invoice processing
      deliverables:
        minConfidence: 0.8
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Deliverable list drives project milestone tracking and acceptance workflow; incomplete extraction
          causes gaps in obligation management
      governing_law:
        minConfidence: 0.82
        reviewOnBreach: false
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Governing law determines applicable contract and dispute rules; lower threshold acceptable as this
          rarely changes payment workflows
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-claude-haiku
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Statements of Work require careful extraction of structured financial data (contract value, payment
      schedules, pricing model), project deliverables with associated dates, and governance provisions (IP
      ownership, change order process). SOW documents often include structured tables for deliverable
      schedules and payment milestones that require table-parsing capabilities. Claude Sonnet is preferred for
      its strong numerical accuracy, ability to distinguish T&M caps from fixed prices, and reliable
      extraction of multi-row deliverable tables. The token budget (6144) balances coverage of typical SOW
      lengths (10-30 pages) with cost efficiency. Temperature 0.0 ensures consistent financial field
      extraction. Claude Haiku serves as fallback for simple single-deliverable SOWs or time-constrained
      processing queues.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      sow_number:
        type: string
        description: 'The unique SOW identifier or reference number (e.g., "SOW-2025-007", "SOW #3")'
      sow_title:
        type: string
        description: Descriptive title of the statement of work
      effective_date:
        type: date
        description: The date the SOW becomes effective, format YYYY-MM-DD
        format: date
      end_date:
        type: date
        description: The date the SOW terminates or the project is expected to complete, format YYYY-MM-DD
        format: date
      amendment_number:
        type: string
        description: If this is an amendment to an existing SOW, the amendment number as integer (null if original)
      client_name:
        type: string
        description: Full legal name of the client organization
      client_contact:
        type: string
        description: Name of the primary client contact person (project manager, sponsor, or signatory)
      client_po_number:
        type: string
        description: Client's Purchase Order number referenced in the SOW (null if not present)
      vendor_name:
        type: string
        description: Full legal name of the vendor / service provider organization
      vendor_contact:
        type: string
        description: Name of the primary vendor contact person (project manager or account manager)
      project_description:
        type: string
        description: Brief description of the project or engagement scope (up to 300 characters)
      deliverables:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: "Array of deliverable objects. Each object must contain:"
      name:
        type: string
        description: Short name of the deliverable
      description:
        type: string
        description: Brief description of the deliverable (up to 150 chars)
      due_date:
        type: date
        description: Due date in format YYYY-MM-DD (null if not specified for this deliverable)
        format: date
      pricing_model:
        type: string
        description: "The pricing structure. One of: Fixed | T&M | Retainer | Milestone | Other"
      total_contract_value:
        type: number
        description: Total value of the SOW as decimal (null if T&M with no cap, or retainer with no stated total)
      currency:
        type: string
        description: Currency code (e.g., "USD", "EUR", "GBP")
      payment_terms:
        type: number
        description: Payment terms as stated (e.g., "Net 30", "50% upfront / 50% on completion", "Monthly in arrears")
      payment_schedule:
        type: number
        description: Description of the payment schedule or milestones for billing (up to 200 chars)
      acceptance_criteria_described:
        type: string
        description: Boolean — true if the SOW contains defined acceptance criteria for deliverables
      change_order_process_described:
        type: string
        description: Boolean — true if the SOW describes a change order or change control process
      ip_ownership:
        type: string
        description: "Who owns intellectual property created under this SOW. One of: Client | Vendor | Joint | null"
      governing_law:
        type: string
        description: The state or jurisdiction whose laws govern the SOW (e.g., "CA", "NY", "DE")
    required:
      - effective_date
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: contracts
    outputContract:
      fields_object: extracted_fields
      confidence_object: confidence
      metadata_object: extraction_metadata
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - effective_date
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - financials
          - parties
          - risk_and_compliance
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields: []
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
